WITH r AS (
  SELECT
    jr.job_id,
    -- c.name AS job_name,
    jr.run_id,
    jr.job_parameters,
    jr.trigger_type,
    max_by(jr.result_state, jr.period_end_time) AS result_state,
    min(jr.period_start_time) AS run_start_time,
    max(jr.period_end_time)   AS run_end_time,
    max(jr.period_start_time) AS last_attempt_start_time,
    max(jr.run_duration_seconds) AS run_duration_seconds,
    c.report_type,
    c.report_frequency,
    c.report_schedule,
    c.report_job_category,
    c.report_job_name AS job_name,
    c.report_name
  FROM system.lakeflow.job_run_timeline jr
  JOIN system.lakeflow.jobs j
    ON j.job_id = jr.job_id
  INNER JOIN  `qa-reportinputfiles`.default.report_monitoring_config_v2 c
on c.report_job_id = j.job_id
  WHERE jr.result_state IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY jr.job_id, jr.run_id, jr.job_parameters, C.report_type, C.report_frequency, c.report_schedule, c.report_job_category, jr.trigger_type, c.report_job_name, c.report_name
),
t_last_attempt AS (
  SELECT
    t.job_id,
    t.job_run_id AS run_id,
    t.task_key,
    r.report_job_category,
    max_by(t.result_state, t.period_end_time) AS task_state
  FROM system.lakeflow.job_task_run_timeline t
  JOIN r
    ON r.job_id = t.job_id
   AND r.run_id = t.job_run_id
  WHERE t.period_start_time >= r.last_attempt_start_time
    AND t.result_state IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY t.job_id, t.job_run_id, t.task_key, r.report_job_category
),

t_agg_single AS (
  SELECT
    job_id,
    run_id,
    to_json(
      map_from_entries(
        collect_list(named_struct('key', task_key, 'value', task_state))
      )
    ) AS report_status_json
  FROM t_last_attempt
  WHERE task_state <> 'SUCCEEDED'
  AND report_job_category = 'single'
  GROUP BY job_id, run_id
),

t_agg_multiple AS (
  SELECT
    job_id,
    run_id,
    task_key,
    task_state,
    to_json(
      map_from_entries(
        collect_list(
          CASE 
            WHEN task_state <> 'SUCCEEDED' 
            THEN named_struct('key', task_key, 'value', task_state)
          END
        )
      )
    ) AS report_status_json
    -- to_json(
    --   map_from_entries(
    --     collect_list(named_struct('key', task_key, 'value', task_state))
    --   )
    -- ) AS report_status_json
  FROM t_last_attempt
  WHERE report_job_category = 'multiple'
  GROUP BY job_id, run_id, task_key, task_state
),

-- real elapsed from ALL slices, but only for runs that exist in r (population stays the same)
r_time AS (
  SELECT
    jr.job_id,
    jr.run_id,
    timestampdiff(SECOND, min(jr.period_start_time), max(jr.period_end_time)) AS real_elapsed_seconds
  FROM system.lakeflow.job_run_timeline jr
  JOIN r
    ON r.job_id = jr.job_id
   AND r.run_id = jr.run_id
  GROUP BY jr.job_id, jr.run_id
)

SELECT
  r.job_id,
  r.job_name,
  CASE WHEN r.report_job_category = 'multiple' THEN t_agg_multiple.task_key ELSE r.report_name END AS report_name,
  r.report_type,
  r.report_frequency,
  r.run_id,
  CASE WHEN r.report_job_category = 'multiple' THEN t_agg_multiple.task_state ELSE r.result_state END AS result_state,
  r.report_schedule,
  CAST(r.job_parameters AS STRING) AS job_parameters,
  CASE WHEN r.report_job_category = 'multiple' THEN COALESCE(t_agg_multiple.report_status_json, to_json(map())) ELSE COALESCE(t_agg_single.report_status_json, to_json(map())) END AS report_status_json,
  r.run_start_time,
  r.run_end_time,
  rt.real_elapsed_seconds,
  r.trigger_type,
  CASE WHEN r.report_frequency = 'daily' AND r.job_id IN('93076003251411','924226138564910') AND size(r.job_parameters) = 0 THEN rc_1_1.PreviousBusinessDay
       WHEN r.report_frequency = 'daily'  AND size(r.job_parameters) = 0 THEN rc_1.PreviousBusinessDay
       WHEN r.report_frequency = 'monthly'  AND size(r.job_parameters) = 0 THEN rc_2.CalendarDate
       WHEN r.report_frequency = 'quarterly'  AND size(r.job_parameters) = 0 THEN rc_3.CalendarDate
  END AS report_run_date,
  CASE WHEN size(r.job_parameters) = 0 THEN 'Scheduled' ELSE 'Adhoc' END report_run_type
FROM r
LEFT JOIN t_agg_single
  ON r.job_id = t_agg_single.job_id
 AND r.run_id = t_agg_single.run_id
LEFT JOIN t_agg_multiple
  ON r.job_id = t_agg_multiple.job_id
 AND r.run_id = t_agg_multiple.run_id
LEFT JOIN r_time rt
  ON r.job_id = rt.job_id
 AND r.run_id = rt.run_id
 LEFT JOIN `p-cdh`.reference.ref_calendar rc_1
   ON cast(r.run_start_time as date) = rc_1.CalendarDate
 LEFT JOIN `p-cdh`.reference.ref_calendar rc_1_1
   ON rc_1.PreviousBusinessDay = rc_1_1.CalendarDate 
 LEFT JOIN (SELECT MAX(CalendarDate) CalendarDate, LastDateOfMonth
            FROM `p-cdh`.reference.ref_calendar
            WHERE IsBusinessDay = 1
            GROUP BY LastDateOfMonth) rc_2
   ON last_day(add_months(cast(r.run_start_time as date), -1)) = rc_2.LastDateOfMonth
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT MAX(CalendarDate) CalendarDate, LastDateOfQuarter
            FROM `p-cdh`.reference.ref_calendar
            WHERE IsBusinessDay = 1
            GROUP BY LastDateOfQuarter) rc_3
   ON last_day(add_months(trunc(cast(r.run_start_time as date), 'quarter'), -1)) = rc_3.LastDateOfQuarter 
 order by r.run_start_time desc

WITH r AS (
  SELECT
    jr.job_id,
    j.name AS job_name,
    jr.run_id,
    max_by(jr.result_state, jr.period_end_time) AS result_state,
    max(jr.period_start_time) AS last_attempt_start_time,
    c.report_type,
    c.report_frequency,
    c.report_job_category
  FROM system.lakeflow.job_run_timeline jr
  JOIN system.lakeflow.jobs j
    ON j.job_id = jr.job_id
  JOIN `qa-reportinputfiles`.default.report_monitoring_config_v2 c
    ON c.report_job_id = j.job_id
  WHERE j.name NOT LIKE 'New Job %'
    AND jr.result_state IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    jr.job_id, j.name, jr.run_id, c.report_type, c.report_frequency, c.report_job_category
),

t_last_attempt AS (
  SELECT
    t.job_id,
    t.job_run_id AS run_id,
    t.task_key,
    r.report_job_category,
    r.result_state,
    max_by(t.result_state, t.period_end_time) AS task_state
  FROM system.lakeflow.job_task_run_timeline t
  JOIN r
    ON r.job_id = t.job_id
   AND r.run_id = t.job_run_id
  WHERE t.period_start_time >= r.last_attempt_start_time
    AND t.result_state IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY t.job_id, t.job_run_id, t.task_key, r.report_job_category, r.result_state
),

r_time AS (
  SELECT
    jr.job_id,
    jr.run_id,
    timestampdiff(
      SECOND,
      min(jr.period_start_time),
      max(jr.period_end_time)
    ) AS real_elapsed_seconds
  FROM system.lakeflow.job_run_timeline jr
  JOIN r
    ON r.job_id = jr.job_id
   AND r.run_id = jr.run_id
  GROUP BY jr.job_id, jr.run_id
)

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN t.report_job_category = 'multiple' AND t.task_state = 'SUCCEEDED' OR t.report_job_category = 'single' AND t.result_state = 'SUCCEEDED' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) / COUNT(*) AS success_rate,
  SUM(CASE WHEN t.report_job_category = 'multiple' AND t.task_state <> 'SUCCEEDED' OR t.report_job_category = 'single' AND t.result_state <> 'SUCCEEDED' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) / COUNT(*) AS fail_rate,
  AVG(rt.real_elapsed_seconds) AS avg_elapsed_seconds,
  concat(
    lpad(cast(floor(AVG(rt.real_elapsed_seconds) / 3600) AS STRING), 2, '0'), ':',
    lpad(cast(floor((AVG(rt.real_elapsed_seconds) % 3600) / 60) AS STRING), 2, '0'), ':',
    lpad(cast(floor(AVG(rt.real_elapsed_seconds) % 60) AS STRING), 2, '0')
  ) AS avg_elapsed_hms
FROM t_last_attempt t
LEFT JOIN r_time rt
  ON t.job_id = rt.job_id
 AND t.run_id = rt.run_id;
